items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview
items.q: And Dave Williams' mother, which I know you know him, Dave. His mother is ours as two cousins.

ctx.x: And you might tell about your other brothers, too. I know you're younger.

Yeah, well, I have another brother which died in 49. My name is Alec Fraser. He was a piano player. He started off... Dave Williams, the piano player now playing in the French quarters. And he started a cousin of mine who died, too, called Mitchell Fraser. That was my father's youngest brother, Michelle Fraser. He started him out of play. Then he made... He played a while. He died in 49, yeah. And Dave Williams' mother, which I know you know him, Dave. His mother is ours as two cousins.

items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1974-03-28
items.q: Saif Frazier, Lawrence Marrero, all that's family.

ctx.x: Oh, you didn't tell me much about Miele Barnes.

Well, Miele, I knew Miele all my life. Miele related to me. But I never played with him or, you know, and the only time I really got to really him, Miele, been a nice fellow all the days, but the only time I got to him was, you know, when he's the preservation, all opened up and all that, you know. But like Miele, Paul Barnes, all that's my relatives, Saif Frazier, Lawrence Marrero, all that's family. Very close too. Sisters and brothers, children, you know.
